confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Vienna price levels, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately confident; accommodation anchors are less certain because July is peak season and rates vary widely by district and booking lead time. Drink anchors are estimates. The FX observation is taken from search-result summaries and was not confirmed by opening the rba.gov.au page; earlier cached results showed a different March 2026 value.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Munich and Prague as general reference points, with Vienna's restaurant and summer hotel prices placed above Prague and close to Munich. No live listings were consulted.
